title: MZ The EXP bars on the Victory Aftermath page

posts.author: CSpringer205
posts.body: In my game, I have eight party members, but I'm facing an issue where three experience (EXP) bars have blocked my view of the experience and gold I've collected. While I can see the number of items obtained on the right side, there are none displayed in the current screenshot. I would appreciate a solution that allows me to shorten the length of the EXP bars and arrange them into two columns and four rows for better visibility. Thank you. The plugin I've used for this thread is VisuStella's Victory Aftermath plugin.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
That would be annoying to try and do (at least without running the code in a deobfuscator or using AI). There's multiple obfuscated methods drawing those different elements.
Send a message to VisuStella that it's overlapping and see if they want to fix it. They might since looking at that pic it seems like it would overlap even if you didn't have 8 battlers (which is pretty extreme). Or maybe you'll get lucky and someone here helps you.
EDIT: Of course you can also always try write the whole draw methods yourself, completely replacing it.
